Upload a single image or a batch of images and resize them by specifying dimensions in pixels or by percentage, with options to maintain the original aspect ratio. When processing multiple images, results are bundled into a ZIP file for easy download.

toolInfo.longDescription: An image watermark tool lets you add customizable text watermarks to one or more images. You can automatically use each image's filename as the watermark or apply the same custom text to every image. Watermarks help protect your work, identify ownership, promote your brand, and organize image collections. Customize the font size, opacity, color, and position while preserving the original image quality.
toolInfo.title: What is Watermark Images ?
